transcript:
Now I'll take you through the different parts of the museum.
The area called Four Seasons is positioned partly inside and partly beyond the main gallery.
It shows a four-minute animated woodland scene, created especially for us by young people studying film.
It's a lovely piece, and adults enjoy it just as much as children do.
Our main gallery, Town and Country, contains photographs of award-winning sheep and the people who look after them.
From there, you move into Farmhouse Kitchen, whose theme is fairly obvious.
It houses the country's oldest collection of butter and cheese-making equipment.
This morning, a specialist cheesemaker is demonstrating the process, and visitors may even be able to taste the results.
Next, there are two possible directions.
The staircase on the right leads to a landing overlooking the galleries.
On the left is a year on the farm.
We sometimes use that room for school visits, so it has plenty of seats and is a convenient place to rest.
Anyone who wants a challenge can also try our memory quiz, answering questions about exhibits they've already seen.
The following section is Wagon Walk, with farm carts collected from almost every region of the country.
The differences between the areas are quite striking, and information panels beside the carts explain each one.
Because these vehicles are old and delicate, adults must keep children close and make sure they don't climb on them.
After Wagon Walk, you may return to reception, head into the garden, or revisit the galleries, so you aren't restricted to one route.
Beezer Magic is in the garden's far corner.
That section is currently being redeveloped, so it isn't open today, although honey from the museum is still available in the shop.
The last place is the pond, home to several kinds of wildlife.
There are ducklings only a few days old, as well as tiny frogs.
The water is shallow and surrounded by a fence, making the area safe for children.

flow.text_vi: Four Seasons và phòng tranh chính: bắt đầu hành trình với bộ phim hoạt hình do sinh viên làm và khu triển lãm ảnh về vùng nông thôn.
